title: The WSMS (formerly WP SMS): SMS Notifications, OTP Login and WooCommerce SMS plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to…
description: The WSMS (formerly WP SMS) WordPress plugin up to version 7.2.14 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users with author-level access or higher to send arbitrary SMS messages from the site. This flaw arises because the plugin does not properly verify user authorization for certain actions, enabling misuse of the site's trusted sender ID. Exploitation can lead to unwanted SMS charges for the site owner and facilitate SMS spam or phishing campaigns.
